data.description: Wave-0 sweep, ships first. (1) VERIFY the headshot upload fix (1fc2e2e) works on the LIVE public CFP form at marquee.stage11.dev — browser session, real file; it cost 63 turns in run 1 and is unverified post-fix; report the result loudly before anything else. (2) Fix the four false routes in .eval-kit/evalconfig.json submissionNotes (/site does not exist; /comms -> /communications; /settings/webhooks does not exist; /agenda is public, builder is /agenda-builder) AND build a generator: script in scripts/checks/ emitting the ROUTES block from route-table.ts + app.tsx public predicate, failing the PR gate on drift. (3) Sidebar rows: Embeds -> /embed/config; sidebar:true for /submissions; entry for /submissions/new. (4) Restore the removed 'Agenda data' feed link on the public agenda. (5) ?status=accepted escape hatch: when stage filter yields 0 but accepted_any>0, inline note 'N accepted overall - view all' with param-swap link. (6) De-dress the fake event switcher (Sidebar.tsx:11 event-switcher class around a plain /dashboard link). NOTE: submissionNotes edits live in .eval-kit/evalconfig.json which is gitignored third-party — edit it in place in the PRIMARY checkout (allowed exception, it is not committed), and put the generator + a committed copy of truthful notes text in the repo. Full spec: section T-Z of sequence/eval-response-tickets.md. Register rows 51-52 + free-wins list.
data.title: Wave 0: eval free wins and truthful notes

data.body:
MRQ-106 complete — PR #75 (https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/75), status pr_open.
Branch `mrq-106-wave0-sweep` @ `7a43785`, off `github/main @ 23a06b0`.

**GATE RESULT (item 1, reported loudly before all else): THE LIVE HEADSHOT UPLOAD IS FIXED.**
Real browser session against `marquee.stage11.dev` (live build `709f9ca7`, which has `1fc2e2e` as an
ancestor); a real 256×256 PNG through the real file input leaves the field reading
`Saved file: mrq106-probe.png`, which `setAnswer()` sets only after **sign → R2 PUT → complete**
all resolve (`PublicForm.tsx:373-385`). No page error. Nothing downstream is blocked; CFP-S2's 43
turns and CFP-S3's 20 are recovered.

**LOCAL GATE: 546/546 tests pass; every check green except the 45s suite objective (85954ms).**
Four runs, same verdict every time, elapsed tracking machine load rather than the diff: 90s, 70s,
52s, 86s at 1-minute loads of 147, 89, 53, 52 on a box running roughly twenty agents. Reported red
because it is red; it is a load verdict, not a defect verdict, and I did not touch the budget to
make it green.

**DEVIATE-WITH-FLAG, three:**

1. **The escape-hatch trigger.** The ticket said "stage filter yields 0 while `accepted_any` > 0".
   On real data both locally and live, `?status=accepted` returns **1 of 62** — MRQ-100's stage
   seeding closed the zero case. Shipping it literally would ship a control nobody sees and leave
   the worse failure standing, because a list of one reads as an answer where an empty list reads
   as a filter that missed. The note now fires on the **gap**; the zero case keeps its own larger
   escape in the empty state.
2. **`tests/unit/route-table.test.ts` pins the sidebar order as a CONTRACT against the binding
   prototype.** The three new rows depart from it. Updated and annotated in the test; `DESIGN.md`
   untouched, no AC minted. Yours to ratify or reverse.
3. **The `Agenda data ↗` link.** MRQ-94 removed it *and* pinned its absence in a contract test —
   rightly: it carried the event and nothing else, so a filtered agenda offered a feed of a
   different program. Restoring it unscoped would have re-armed exactly that, so it carries
   day/track/q now and the contract test requires the scope instead of the absence.

**REVIEW:** the auto-fired single reviewer died at 159s on `You've hit your session limit · resets
6am (America/New_York)` — not on the code. Fell back to self-review per COMMON's timebox rule;
attached, verdict PASS over commit `e7a85d5`, one Major finding found and fixed (two competing
escapes on one screen; now exactly one owner per state).

**SHARED FILES:** `PublicAgendaPage.tsx` (rule 5, T-I's) — one header anchor, named by both T-Z
item 4 and T-K step 2. `route-table.ts` (rule 6, trivial).

**VALIDATION GAP, stated plainly:** the accepted-count note was not seen rendering in a browser.
Every client-side `fetch` in the c11 WKWebView surface 401s against the local dev server because
the session cookie is `Secure` and the dev origin is `http` — no client-fetch behaviour is
validatable there, for this change or any other. Covered instead by unit tests over the real
seed's own numbers plus source assertions on the reserved-space markup.

**eval-kit notes** edited in place in the PRIMARY checkout only; `git check-ignore` confirms it is
ignored and `git status` shows no `.eval-kit` path. Two further lies fixed while there: the
MULTI-EVENT paragraph's "opens a modal that says 'Not installed'" (there is no modal) and the
"`/evaluation/ai` surface exists" claim (no such route; a test has asserted its absence for a while).

**MRQ-106 rebased and re-pushed — PR #75 is MERGEABLE again.** Branch `mrq-106-wave0-sweep` @ `2eb5e56`, now on top of `github/main @ fd977f1`. Status stays `pr_open`; the Merge Warden merges.

**Conflicts, all real code, all mine to resolve — two files, three hunks:**

1. `package.json` — MRQ-125 added `check:shell-truth` on the line my `check:routes` landed on. Kept both.
2. `PublicAgendaPage.tsx` ×2 — MRQ-121 added a `Speakers` button to the same `actions` prop my `Agenda data ↗` link went into, and my later commit rewrote that link to carry the page's filters. Resolved to all three buttons, with the feed link keeping its `feedQuery` scope: **Speakers · Agenda data ↗ · Get embed code**.

`route-table.ts` and `Sidebar.tsx` auto-merged clean despite MRQ-125 landing in both — MRQ-125's `/import` relabel and my three new rows are disjoint.

**Generated artifacts, regenerated rather than hand-resolved:**

- `cli/api-registry.json` — `check:api` failed on `cli-registry-hash-mismatch`. Ran `node cli/generate-api-registry.mjs`. **Worth a look: the 134 operations were byte-identical; only the document hash moved.** The drift is a description or summary string somewhere in a recently-merged PR whose author did not regenerate — which means `main` itself is likely carrying a stale registry right now, and the next delegator to rebase will hit this same red. I did not verify that against `main` directly (it needs its own build), so treat it as a strong suspicion rather than a finding.
- `docs/ROUTES.md` — regenerated by my own `check:routes`, which **caught main's changes by itself**: MRQ-121's `/speakers` public page and MRQ-125's `/import` → "Import speakers" relabel, plus the new `/speakers` clause in `app.tsx`'s `isPublicPage` predicate (8 clauses parsed, all consistent). That is the generator earning its place on its first contact with someone else's merge.

**GATE after the rebase — every check green except the 45s wall clock:**

```
worker types ✓  client types ✓  test types ✓  production build ✓
shell truth ✓  design contract ✓  API contract ✓  route map ✓
hermetic fast suite:  Test Files 88 passed (88) · Tests 553 passed (553)
   OVER BUDGET: 59971ms against a 45000ms objective
{ "command": "pr-gate", "ticket": "MRQ-106", "status": "fail", "failedCheck": "hermetic fast suite" }
```

553/553 pass, including main's 7 new tests. Same time-only verdict as before the rebase, at 1-minute load 90–105. Five runs now, every one of them green on substance and red on the clock alone.

**PR state:** `mergeable=MERGEABLE`, `mergeStateStatus=UNSTABLE` only because the GitHub `fast-gate` was still running when I checked. Nothing left on my side.

No dev server left running and no browser surface opened this round.

**MRQ-106 — CI failure fixed, and the local gate is fully green for the first time.** Branch `mrq-106-wave0-sweep` @ `3aaa523`, rebased onto `github/main @ 514f9f4`.

## The real failure was mine, and the brief's attribution was off

`co-speaker` and `embeds` did **not** arrive from main. Both are rows this branch added — `git show github/main:src/ui/shell/route-table.ts | grep -c 'id: "embeds"\|id: "co-speaker"'` → **0**. So this was my defect to fix at the source, not an expectation to rubber-stamp.

**What is true:** both are honestly outside the admin shell, for two different reasons I checked in the code rather than assumed.

- `embeds` → `/embed/config` is served by `embed.route.tsx` and `app.tsx` classifies every `/embed/` path as a public page, so AppShell never mounts there. This is exactly why the sidebar row carries `external: true` — a client-side push would draw "this route is not installed" over a builder that works.
- `co-speaker` → `AppShell` returns `<CoSpeakerPage />` before it draws the chrome, in the same early-return block as `/portal` and `/reviewer`. `AppShell.tsx:95` already names all three as `isNonAdminShell`.

So the expectation grows. **But the assertion is protecting something real, and growing it alone would have hollowed it out.** `external: true` is the easiest thing in this repo to reach for when a screen will not cooperate, and reaching for it silently removes that screen from the shared QuickSearch mount AC-101 exists to guarantee. Pinning the set catches an *addition*; it does not catch a *dodge*.

The test now reads `app.tsx` and `AppShell.tsx` and requires **every** `external: true` row to be justified by one of the two mechanisms above, naming the offending route in the failure message. Pinned list kept as well, so a new row is still a deliberate diff.

Verified the new assertion actually bites, in isolation: removing AppShell's `/co-speaker` early return leaves the pinned list untouched and fails with
`route "co-speaker" (/co-speaker) is marked external: true, but AppShell renders it — it belongs inside the shared shell, not outside it`.
Both files restored; `git diff` on them is empty.

## A second failure the CI run had not reached yet

`merged AC trace` failed with **9 × `invalid-title-prefix`** — all nine mine. `trace-ac-core.mjs:45` requires `AC-N ·` or `CONTRACT ·`; my titles led with the ticket. They are `CONTRACT` rows (this ticket mints no AC ID), now spelled `CONTRACT · MRQ-106 · …`, matching `CONTRACT · MRQ-99 · …` already in the repo.

## Generated artifacts

- `docs/ROUTES.md` — regenerated; picked up MRQ-115's `/files` on its own.
- `cli/api-registry.json` — **the first regeneration was wrong and I caught it**: `generate-api-registry.mjs` reads `dist/marquee/index.js`, and my bundle was stale, so it wrote 134 operations from the old build. Rebuilt first, then regenerated: **135** operations, the new one being `GET /api/v1/events/{eventId}/files listConferenceFiles`. That also settles last round's suspicion — main's registry was genuinely stale, missing MRQ-115's operation, and anyone rebasing onto it hits the same red until this lands.

## Gate — green, all of it

```
worker types ✓  client types ✓  test types ✓  production build ✓
shell truth ✓  design contract ✓  API contract ✓  route map ✓
hermetic fast suite:  Test Files 90 passed (90) · Tests 572 passed (572)  — 34327ms, INSIDE the 45s budget
merged AC trace ✓
{ "command": "pr-gate", "ticket": "MRQ-106", "elapsedMs": 38248 }   GATE_RC=0
```

## On the OVER BUDGET noise — noted, not chased

It is contention, and today's numbers prove it rather than assert it. Same code, same box, four measurements:

| 1-min load | Suite |
|---|---|
| ~100 | 172s |
| ~76 | 144s |
| ~56 | 65s |
| **37** | **34s ✓** |

The cost is concentrated in worker `import` time (465s–1162s summed across workers), which is precisely what collapses when twenty agents share a machine. CI's 149815ms is the same shape on a smaller runner; #74 and #77 passing in ~3m is consistent with them having drawn a quieter runner, not with a defect in this branch. The suite has grown to 90 files / 572 tests and its best case here is now 34s against a 45s budget — real headroom loss worth someone's attention, but not mine to chase and not this PR's to fix.

PR #75 is pushed and ready for the Merge Warden. No dev server left running, no browser surface opened.

Board reconciliation 2026-08-12: verified DONE. PR #75 (mrq-106-wave0-sweep) merged 2026-08-12T14:14:29Z; merge commit ccb78850 confirmed an ancestor of github/main via 'git merge-base --is-ancestor'. Ticket had drifted at pr_open. No open or closed-unmerged PRs exist on the repo. Status corrected to reflect merge, not PR-open.
